subject: Private deployment: environment validation & evidence collection
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightvision.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: it@brightvision.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment: final env validation & artifacts request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're lining up the final pre-production window (targeting Oct 12–14) and need to collect the evidence artifacts Redwood requires for the environment validation gate. Can you please provide the items below by EOD Monday (Oct 5) so our infra team can confirm routing and policy before the handoff?

Requested artifacts (high priority):
- VPC/CIDR map (subnets, AZ mapping) and proposed route table associations (file or diagram)
- BGP/Interconnect details for the dedicated connection (ASN, prefixes, MD5 if used)
- Service account list (email/iam id) that Redwood will use + least-privilege roles
- KMS key identifier and a short policy snippet showing key usage permissions
- Egress allowlist + sample egress test IPs and ports
- A 24-hour audit log extract (redacted) showing token issuance and model-request patterns
- Host/service inventory for any customer-located GPUs (if applicable)

Attachments: I attached our current diagram (bv_current_architecture.drawio) — note we plan to add a private interconnect to the east-1 region.

If there's anything you need from our side (ASN allocation, peering IPs), call that out and I'll loop in our network lead.

Appreciate the help — this is the last set of artifacts we need before we lock the cutover window.

—Sara Liu
IT Operations Lead
BrightVision Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level notes below and attaching the documents we already produce for every Private deployment.

Quick reply with deliverables we will provide:
- VPC map: attached (bv_vpc_diagram_v1.pdf). Diagram includes subnets, AZ placement and the proposed route table mapping we'll use for the Dedicated edge.
- BGP/Interconnect: we will send a short BGP worksheet with ASN/prefixes; preliminary ASN for Redwood endpoint: 65043 (we'll confirm MD5 requirement).
- Service accounts: attached CSV (redwood_service_account_table.csv) with account email, intended role, and required resource scope. Please confirm you can review IAM changes in your account; if not, we can provide a deployment plan that uses customer-managed service accounts.
- KMS: attached snippet (redwood_kms_policy_snippet.txt) — this shows the minimal key_policy we need to allow envelope encryption. We never export raw keys; Redwood only requests Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions scoped to our service principal.
- Egress allowlist: see diagram notes and the allowed destination list in the CSV comments.
- Audit logs: we do not ship customer audit logs back to Redwood; we can provide a redacted token-issuance extract (sample) on request. For privacy, recommend an s3/staged link for transfer.
- Host inventory: if you have customer-located GPUs, send the host list; otherwise our Dedicated run uses Redwood-managed instances in your VPC.

Attachments included in this message: bv_vpc_diagram_v1.pdf, redwood_service_account_table.csv, redwood_kms_policy_snippet.txt

Next steps: Marcus will run a short connectivity validation checklist (BGP + NAT + MTU) and flag anything that needs a config exception. Kimberley will coordinate the SOC/preflight checklist items and confirm the audit-log handoff procedure.

I'll mark Oct 5 internal deadline and loop back with any follow-ups.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: final env validation & artifacts request

Grace — quick technical check-in. I ran a connectivity preflight against BrightVision's staging interconnect (using the IPs Sara shared) and have the following notes: 

- BGP: session established from our side using ASN 65043 -> your advertised prefixes were accepted. We saw occasional BGP flap with the second-longest prefix; please confirm if route-reflector timers differ on your edge.
- MTU: we saw a 1460 MTU on the transit path; recommend we set DF bit handling to avoid fragmentation for large model payloads.
- NAT/Source IP: confirmed outbound originates from the customer-managed NAT gateway when we run in customer VPC mode. If BrightVision prefers Redwood-managed egress, we need the egress allowlist updated.
- KMS: validated AWS KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 matches the policy snippet but we need the key policy to include the Redwood service principal arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-service (see attached snippet for exact principal format).

I've uploaded the customer-side artifacts to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExample (contains our peering worksheet + staging host inventory). Once you confirm the final BGP prefix set, I'll sign off on the Oct 12–14 window.
